_comment: Resource-page capacity and cost model. Written from Settings → Resource model through api/update-resmodel.js, the same way outlook.json is written from the Resource page. Only OVERRIDES are stored: an empty object means the shipped estimate in lib/coverage.cjs (capacity) and RES_COST_DEFAULTS in index.html (cost) is still in use. Keys are validated by the endpoint — anything it does not recognise is dropped rather than committed.
